subject: general
question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at XY as shown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/052e871fa62c9f7d856d5c5296467c80169d3585993f136aa48908f94fe30757.png]
solution:
In a mirror image LEFT CHANGES TO RIGHT AND THE RIGHT CHANGES TO LEFT and vice-versa.**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69c7b55fa9b835b89418050caf164a391d21aea931c1adbc57cd9d45d92b6757.png] 

From the given options,

Option 1) The pattern is inverted and it does not match.

Option 2) The pattern is inverted and it is reversed so it does not match.

Option 3) The pattern matches completely.

Option 4) The pattern is mirrored but in the wrong order.

Hence the correct answer is option 3)**
